evidence.citation: Artifact: "Re-run the case independently 2–3 times when it matters or the result is borderline, then report the rate ... re-evaluate every golden case with fresh blind runners and separate judges. Verify the live checkout remains clean after runs".
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s execution work is tied to confirming evaluation mode, replacing a mismatched bar, checking reproducibility with limited reruns when warranted, re-evaluating after any edit, and verifying checkout cleanliness. Under the supplied bar, those are necessary validation and integrity controls rather than materially unnecessary work.
